Here, $A$ is a $2\times 3$ matrix and $B$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $3$ columns in $A$ and $3$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{2\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 2}={AB}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute the unknown elements of $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-3 & ∗ \\ ∗ & -8\end{aligned}], &  & \,-3=1\cdot 2+2\cdot (-1)+(-1)\cdot 3 \\  & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 3 \\ 9 & -8\end{aligned}], &  & \,-8=0\cdot 1+3\cdot 0+4\cdot (-2)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
AB=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 3 \\ 9 & -8\end{aligned}].
$$
